name: CompletelyRegularSpace.exists_BCNN
statement: Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [CompletelyRegularSpace X] {K : Set X} (K_closed : IsClosed K) {x : X} (x_notin_K : x ∉ K) : ∃ (f : X →ᵇ ℝ≥0), f x = 1 ∧ (∀ y ∈ K, f y = 0)

name: not_tendsto_diracProba_of_not_tendsto
statement: X} (L : Filter X) (h : ¬ Tendsto id L (𝓝 x)) : ¬ Tendsto diracProba L (𝓝 (diracProba x))

name: tendsto_diracProba_iff_tendsto
statement: X} (L : Filter X) : Tendsto diracProba L (𝓝 (diracProba x)) ↔ Tendsto id L (𝓝 x)
